extension.description: Stream scene release movies and TV shows from ReleaseBB. [COLOR red][B][I]YOU will need a premium Rapidgator/Nitroflare account configured in ResolveUrl to play most links[/B][/I][/COLOR] [COLOR gold][B][I]FREE links are also available on many posts[/B][/I][/COLOR]
extension.disclaimer: All the movies on this add-on are hosted on third party sites and uploaded by other people. We are not responsible for any content hosted on third-party sites. If you have any legal issues please contact the appropriate content owners/hosters.
extension.news: [B][COLOR lime]v1.0.0[/COLOR][/B] - RLSBB Reborn -- full Python 3 rewrite, Kodi 20+ (Nexus and later) only - protected.to captcha-gate resolver, multi-round chains - Season packs open as a proper episode list, not broken playback - Dead links filtered out automatically - MDBList integration: Watchlist, Up Next, Recently Watched, Lists, ratings - Trakt scrobbling support - Multiple site domains + DNS-over-HTTPS (works even if your ISP blocks it) - Remembers your preferred view per section - Quick debrid service login (All-Debrid, Premiumize, TorBox, Real-Debrid)
